metadata.case_name: LEE WOON (OR WAN) SUN v. WONG KIN KEUNG AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: employed as an assistant to a dealer in piece goods on the basis of a salary and commission on sales and in the course of his work travelled about the Colony.
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: continue in the same occupation until 60 or 65 years of age

source: The Plaintiff received severe head injuries, which left him unconscious for three weeks.

injuries.description: serious brain damage resulting in emotional changes, restlessness, drop in general intelligence, memory impairment, aggression and speech disorder
source: there was serious brain damage resulting in emotional changes, restlessness, drop in general intelligence, memory impairment, aggression and speech disorder

injuries.description: probably suffering from epileptic discharges which were causing not only the impairment of speech but also behavioural abnormalities
source: it was decided that he was probably suffering from epileptic discharges which were causing not only the impairment of speech but also behavioural abnormalities.

manifestations.description: weakness of the right arm and hand
weakness of the facial muscle on the right side
weakness of the left arm and hand (complained)

treatments_received: detained in hospital for six weeks
readmitted to hospital nine months later for diagnostic investigation
one test was described as being "particularly painful"

losses.description: emotional changes, restlessness, drop in general intelligence, memory impairment, aggression
impairment of speech and speech disorder
weakness of the right arm and hand, weakness of the left arm and hand, weakness of the facial muscle on the right side

comparable_cases.injury_description: a child of 14 years of age received "quite appalling" injuries which disabled him "to a degree that he needed continuous attention and substantial help from others to cope with daily life"; could not walk without assistance; had double vision requiring a patch over one eye; had undergone four operations including one on an eye which involved stitching the lids closed; showed marked impairment in memory and intelligence; expectation of life reduced to about 35 or 40 years.
